items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: Mr. A, I'm shocked at Grunewald, another man. He used to repair it for me.

ctx.x: Where did you get your instruments repaired? Did the shops at Werleins and other places in
New Orleans do it? When it was Grunewald, you see, Mr. A, I'm shocked at Grunewald, another man. He used to repair it for me. Grunewald? Do you know any of those instruments repairmen there?
Well I don't know, Werleins is the one I always think about. Mr. Eckert, Mr. Eckert. Oh, Eckert, yeah. Lewis Eckert.
